newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dywidag sees slight output rise in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Dywidag sees slight output rise in 1997.

text.p: German building group Dywidag AG said on Wednesday it expected a slight rise in its construction output this year and said profits should remain steady.
Chief executive Hans-Joachim Wolff made the forecast in the text of a speech to be delivered to the company's annual shareholder meeting.
Wolff said a decline in building investment in Germany would not allow for any growth in the industry this year.
Dywidag's 1996 output was 4.114 billion marks ($2.4 billion) and earnings from operating activities were 41.9 million marks.
